SHOPS.Willkommen.Einleitung: A shop here is an NPC or a place with goods in its inventory. You decide who gets to see it — not the players by clicking a token.
SHOPS.Willkommen.Punkt1: Goods and prices — drag items into the inventory, set a markup on the base price or a fixed price per entry, plus one line the shopkeeper says about it.
SHOPS.Willkommen.Punkt2: You show it — to everyone, to single players, or on the table's screen, where the shop stands large and pages by itself. Players can only open it themselves if you allow it.
SHOPS.Willkommen.Punkt3: Buying, on your terms — locked, on approval, or free. Payment comes from the chosen character's purse, change included, and every purchase lands in the market ledger afterwards.
SHOPS.Willkommen.Start: To begin: open an NPC, choose Set up shop in the sheet header and drag goods in.
SHOPS.Willkommen.ForgeZeile: Every module, its documentation and the German translations in one place — see them all
Off: a shop only appears when the gamemaster shows it. On: players may open a shop themselves, provided they can see the actor.
SHOPS.Einstellung.Blaettertakt.Name: Display view page turn (seconds)
SHOPS.Einstellung.Blaettertakt.Hinweis: How long one page stays on the table screen. The gamemaster can pause and step through pages at any time.
SHOPS.Kaufmodus.freigabe: Approval — the gamemaster confirms every purchase
SHOPS.Kaufmodus.direkt: Direct — the purchase goes through as soon as the money is there
SHOPS.Bogen.Name: Shop sheet
SHOPS.Bogen.KeineBegruessung: No greeting. It will appear at the top of the players' window.
SHOPS.Bogen.AuslageLeer: Nothing on the shelves yet. Drag items here from a compendium or the sidebar.
SHOPS.Bogen.Ankauf: What this shop pays for it
SHOPS.Bogen.FestpreisHinweis: Fixed price. Empty means: markup on the base price. A 0 means: free.
SHOPS.Bogen.Verborgen: Under the counter — players do not see it
SHOPS.Bogen.Dienst: Service — costs money, does not change hands
SHOPS.Bogen.WareLoeschenFrage: {name} will be removed from this shop. The item in the compendium is untouched.
SHOPS.Feld.AufschlagHinweis: Factor on the base price. 1.2 is twenty percent on top; 1 is the base price.
SHOPS.Feld.AnkaufHinweis: What this shop pays when buying, also as a factor. 0 means: buys nothing.
SHOPS.Feld.KaufmodusHinweis: Applies to this shop only. Whether players may open a shop at all is a module setting.
SHOPS.Feld.HoechstmengeHinweis: 0 means: no limit. Against the village bought empty.
SHOPS.Feld.EigeneKasseHinweis: Off: unlimited money, the normal case. On: the shop pays buy-backs from this till and can run dry.
SHOPS.Feld.BegruessungPlatzhalter: One or two sentences shown at the top of the players' window.
SHOPS.Vorzeigen.NiemandDa: Nobody is logged in to show it to.
SHOPS.Spieler.AuslageLeer: Nothing is on the shelves right now.
SHOPS.Spieler.KeineFigur: No character assigned — the purse appears once you have one.
SHOPS.Vorzeigen.NiemandSieht: Nobody is looking at it right now.
SHOPS.Spieler.BoerseHinweis: Your character's money. Purchases will later be charged by the gamemaster.
